name: poly(A) specific ribonuclease subunit PAN3
pathways: positive regulation of cytoplasmic mRNA processing body assembly

function.text: PAN3 encodes PAN2-PAN3 deadenylation complex subunit PAN3 (PAB1P-dependent poly(A)-specific ribonuclease) (Poly(A)-nuclease deadenylation complex subunit 3). Annotated molecular activities include poly(A) binding. It participates in nuclear-transcribed mRNA poly(A) tail shortening and positive regulation of cytoplasmic mRNA processing body assembly.

function.text: PAN3 encodes PAN2-PAN3 deadenylation complex subunit PAN3 (PAB1P-dependent poly(A)-specific ribonuclease) (Poly(A)-nuclease deadenylation complex subunit 3). PAN deadenylation is followed by rapid degradation of the shortened mRNA tails by the CCR4-NOT complex. Deadenylated mRNAs are then degraded by two alternative mechanisms, namely exosome-mediated 3'-5' exonucleolytic degradation, or deadenylation-dependent mRNA decapping and subsequent 5'-3' exonucleolytic degradation by XRN1. It has a significant effect on mRNA stability, generally stabilizing a subset of the transcriptome.

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving PAN3 have been reported in b-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma.
